_comment: Explicit exceptions to the local clock-gating rules (tools/check-cg.py, docs/rtl-coding-style.md 'Local clock gating'), written by the module's owner. One entry per module, rule (CG-1, CG-2, CG-3, CG-4, CG-5 or RST-1) and register: module, rule, target, why, by, date. why says what was measured and why the rule cannot or should not be met. A CG-5 waiver also carries ports, the input ports it lets into the enable, and enable_ngd, the enable's total depth: the latest port's arrival plus the cone, within CCV_NGD_CG_EN (OI-59). A waiver that excuses nothing is refused; one beside a ratchet entry supersedes it.
